section.title: Problem
section.p: The current prompt is a two-layer sandwich: one static lore file (18KB, last updated March 20) and 200 raw messages. The lore file claims Runs on Hetzner in Falkenstein at 37.27.71.35 (charlie.1.foo) when the web-facing hostname is less.rest. It says Currently building the distributed compute system about something Mikael finished days ago. It describes Lennart as RELOCATED FROM GOTHENBURG TO MONTREAL like this just happened — it happened March 20.

The summaries exist in the database (54 days, 560K chars) but the bot never sees them — the config uses lore_file mode which replaces all summaries with the single static file. The Headlines pipeline exists at less.rest/froth/headlines but is not wired into the prompt at all.

section.title: Layer 1: Foundation
section.p: Small. Near-permanent. Identity, personality, voice. Trim hard — most of what is currently in the lore file was written for Daniel's other bots and does not need to be in every prompt. Character descriptions should be short. No historical events, no situational claims that decay.

section.title: Layer 2: Headlines
section.p: Slow-decay. Covers day 1 through N-4 days ago. One-line-per-day tabloid headlines from the existing pipeline. Events like THE DEAD POSTMAN, THE XPATH FAMILY TREE, LENNART'S MIGRATION belong here as compressed headlines, not as multi-paragraph narratives in the foundation.

section.title: Layer 3: Full Summaries
section.p: Medium-decay. The real daily summaries for the most recent N days (default 4). Where the bot learns what actually changed. These already exist in the chat_summaries table.

section.title: Layer 4: Recent Messages
section.p: Fast-decay. The raw message window. Look at how the message rendering function makes many parts per message content; this enables granular caching.

section.title: Layer 5: Ephemeral State
section.p: Regenerated per cycle. Model ID, current date and time, Elixir uptime, background task list. Short. No stale claims.

section.title: Rendering Order
section.p: Foundation, Headlines, Full Summaries, Chat Context metadata, Ephemeral State, Recent Messages.

section.title: Implementation
section.p: Modify BotContext.build/2 to accept a list of context layer modules instead of the binary lore_file-or-summaries switch. Each layer implements render/2.
